source.run: level-10 universe run (L10, 300 sweeps, preparation exact06)
source.status: imported run counts, not recomputed by this package

premises.P1_pointer: each quantum carries a spin doublet (pointer) on which the 2 pi rotation acts as -1
premises.P2_gauss_sector: on a Gauss-invariant state the code, register and link-end factors of z multiply to +1, so the 2 pi rotation on physical states equals (-1)^(number of quanta)
premises.P3_vertices: the local vertices are the twelve native currents, the register toggle, gauge-covariant hopping inside a block, the four Yukawa vertices, CPT, and the 27 register channels
premises.P4_lift: the occupations are lifted antisymmetrically; the tick alone admits both lifts
premises.P5_port_sectors: vector and spinor levels carry port loads 2 and -3, seen at flux 11 x load mod 20
premises.P6_closed_carrier: a carrier is a closed icosahedral screen and register classes are face fluxes of seam links

1+1->2.reading: two quark doublets into the antitriplet singlet class (diquark)

1+2->3.reading: quark Yukawa vertex: Q with d^c into the Higgs class

1+3->4.reading: quark mass vertex: Q with the Higgs into u_R or d_R

1+4->5.reading: quark doublet with a right-handed quark into the antitriplet doublet class

1+5->0.reading: annihilation of a left-handed quark doublet with its antiparticle

2+2->4.reading: two right-handed antiquarks into the triplet singlet class

2+3->5.reading: conjugate quark mass vertex: u^c or d^c with the Higgs into anti-Q

2+4->0.reading: annihilation of a right-handed quark with its antiparticle

3+3->0.reading: lepton mass vertex (L with the Higgs into e_R or nu_R); also L Lbar and H Hbar annihilation

scope: Centre classes k = 6Y mod 6 of the five-level code and of the Standard Model fields, flux visibility, class conservation of the reaction types, closed carriers, and the grading fixed by the 2 pi rotation. The class does not carry generation, T3 or rest mass, and colour singlet and octet share a class.
